mapper.select: SELECT c.custom_learning_level_id AS customLearningLevelId, c.asset_type AS assetType, c.percentage AS percentage FROM edu.exam_matrix_custom_learning_level_asset_coverages c JOIN edu.exam_matrix_custom_learning_levels l ON l.id = c.custom_learning_level_id WHERE l.matrix_id = #{matrixId} ORDER BY l.sort_order, c.asset_type
